app.description: Music accompaniment extraction tool based on RoFormer model

input.placeholder: Select or drop audio file / folder

compatibility44100.title: Compatibility mode (Recommended)
compatibility44100.description: Resamples to 44.1 kHz for optimal stability and clean phase residual separation.

sourceSampleRate.title: Preserve source sample rate (Experimental)
sourceSampleRate.description: Attempts to match the source sample rate; minor phase alignment variations may occur.

environment.notInstalledDetail: First-time use requires downloading ~{{download}} of components and at least {{disk}} of disk space.

environment.repairDetail: Runtime dependencies are missing or damaged and need repair before extraction can begin.
environment.unsupportedDetail: This system does not meet minimum runtime requirements.

initialization.title: Initialize Runtime Environment
initialization.description: Initial setup automatically downloads the runtime environment and separation model for offline use after deployment.

cancellation.title: Cancel active operation?
cancellation.initializationConsequence: Runtime initialization will stop. You can restart downloading at any time.
cancellation.processingConsequence: Current song will stop processing. Already completed tracks remain in the output folder.

activity.syncingCudaEnvironment: Downloading and deploying CUDA components (may take several minutes)

completion.title: Extraction complete
completion.summary: Completed files are saved in the output directory.

error.settingsInvalid: Saved settings were invalid and have been reset.
error.manifestInvalid: Runtime environment configuration is invalid. Please repair the environment.
